Bank of China total 51,350,000: parts as printed sum to 44,249,000 — does NOT reconcile (diff 7,101,000 = 7,890,000 − 789,000, i.e. the Hunan misprint).
A. C. A. total 37,855,382: parts as printed (reading 1,774,69 as 177,469) sum to 36,258,161 — does NOT reconcile (diff 1,597,221, consistent with Shensi being 1,774,690).
Total column 209,502,167: parts as printed do not reconcile because of the Hunan and Shensi misprints; using 18,306,342 and 13,151,783 they sum to 209,502,167.
